title: Watch Duty: Raider Patrol
summary: Pillagers have been seen watching the village. The Watch wants them gone before they bring friends.

dialogue.intro: Pillagers on the hill again. Watching. Counting.
offer: Four we've seen. There may be more.
Then you come back and tell us, and we ring the bell.
dialogue.return: They're still up on the hill.
dialogue.reward: No more eyes on the hill. The Watch thanks you.
